notes:
Mid-market product org evaluating Redwood. Started on Hosted API for quick integration; moved to Dedicated evaluation after load spike in Dec. Wants single API for chat + embeddings + reranking. POC summary: stable latency, decent cost profile vs. current setup. Key ask now = pricing construct for Dedicated: commit tiers, predictable burst, overage granularity, ramp schedule across quarters.

- 9/12 initial intro (Avery)

- 11/15 POC metrics reviewed: baseline cost ~1.8x cheaper with batching/caching on Redwood hosted vs self-hosted obs.
- 01/20 Dedicated demo w/ infra team (Riya + Jordan present). Big focus on burst capacity (holiday traffic) and failover.

Quotes:
- "We need a clear path from trial -> committed capacity without surprises on month 1 overage" — Head of Product (M. Alvarez).
- "Latency p50 target 120ms, p95 < 400ms for 1k concurrent users" — infra lead.

Procurement: finance asked for three-tier term options (12/24/36 mo) with ramp schedule and built-in burst pool. Wants overage rates as % of committed rather than flat per-token to simplify forecasting.
